# Draftly

> A free, bilingual (English + Arabic) prompt engineering tool.
> Draftly turns rough ideas into structured, model aware prompts
> for ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Gemini. Offline ready, works
> without a backend.

## What Draftly does

Draftly takes a raw idea (typed, spoken, or attached as a file)
and reshapes it into a polished prompt using one of eight prompt
engineering methods: CRAFT, Task, Role, Zero shot, Few shot, Chain
of thought, Structured, or Critique and improve. Every result is
scored on ten quality dimensions and can be exported or pinned to
a personal library. All processing can run locally in the browser
if the user has no backend configured.

## Who it is for

- Students drafting assignments and study prompts
- Business professionals writing executive summaries and reports
- Developers structuring code review and refactor prompts
- Arabic speakers who want their prompts written in native MSA
- Anyone who wants better answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or Gemini

## Key features

- Eight prompt methods with automatic recommendation
- Quality score from 0 to 100 across ten dimensions
- Side by side comparison of the same idea in five methods
- Voice dictation, file attachments (images, PDF, code, CSV)
- Local session history and personal pinned library
- Full Arabic + English UI with proper RTL layout
- Dark and light themes
- Installable Progressive Web App for Android, iOS, and desktop
